verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Phoenix is free to self-host with no feature limitations, keeps data entirely within your infrastructure, and can be fully air-gapped. Documented deployment paths include CLI (`uvx arize-phoenix serve`), Docker/Compose, Kubernetes, Helm, CloudFormation, and one-click cloud templates, and version-pinned Docker images are recommended for production. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
